entities.name: rACC→Pn neurons
aliases: rostral ACC to pontine nucleus neurons

relationships.subject: rACC→Pn neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: analgesia from the expectation of pain relief is mediated by rostral anterior cingulate cortex (rACC) neurons that project to the pontine nucleus (rACC→Pn)

relationships.subject: naloxone
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of the opioid receptor antagonist naloxone during the post-test, but not during the conditioning phase, abolished this analgesic effect

relationships.subject: placebo analgesia
relationships.evidence_quote: On the post-test day, these neurons showed elevated Ca2+ activity, at the levels of individual neurons (Fig. 2d,e) and of individual mice (Fig. 2f).

key_findings: Pain-relief expectation increases activity and synaptic potentiation of rACC→Pn neurons; inhibiting the pathway disrupts placebo analgesia.
65% of Pn neurons express Oprd1 and/or Oprm1, and Purkinje cells show matching activity during expectation.
